scope: same-equation 600 m moving-child versus oversized stationary Nimbus reference with inherited v7 thresholds, geometry, aperture, containment movement, balanced trusted state, and release-preserving orthogonal containment reserve

orthogonal_containment_reserve_amendment.eligibility: an admitted trusted-interior containment transaction with an orthogonal authoritative approach direction and whole-parent-cell slack above both immutable release faces
orthogonal_containment_reserve_amendment.orthogonal_shift_objective: maximize directional reserve using only whole-parent-cell slack above the opposite release margin

limitations: All numerical thresholds, geometry, aperture, measurement cadence, and v9 balanced-containment rules are inherited from the immutable v7 policy chain.
No comparison metric from the invalid v7 candidate was inspected or used to alter a threshold.
The orthogonal reserve can only accompany an already-admitted trusted-containment transaction and cannot move either orthogonal face inside the immutable release margin.
No current relaxation-zone entry is recoverable, and ambiguity, topology, parent containment, finite evidence, and fail-closed trusted-interior checks remain unchanged.
A pass remains a bounded same-equation fixed-aperture comparison and does not enable public moving_nest selection or broaden supported physics/backend combinations.
